verdict.line: You lose if you let Hallowed Mist farm you down from range; you win once that cooldown is gone and you're already in her face.

brief.thesis: Gwen's kit is built to poke you from outside melee and vanish the instant you commit — Mundo has no disengage answer to that, which is why Mundo sits at 41.6% over 291 games despite a 50.3% overall top lane rate. Your counter isn't outrunning her tools, it's out-healthing and out-ranging them: Infected Cleaver hits from farther than anything she has, and your max-health pool eventually makes her burst irrelevant.

theirWindow.when: Hallowed Mist is up and ready
theirWindow.what: She can poke freely and vanish into the mist the moment you step in range — she can only be targeted by enemies who also enter it, so don't throw Q (Infected Cleaver) or walk up expecting to land anything; wait her out.

yourWindow.when: she's just used Hallowed Mist to poke or farm
yourWindow.what: That's 18-22s (scaling by rank) with no disengage. Walk her down, land Q (Infected Cleaver), and commit to melee range where W (Burning Agony) and your health pool do the work.

powerCurve.note: Q range trades even with her early poke
Her cone Q and E dash out-trade you
Needlework adds ranged poke you can't answer
Heartsteel/Warmog's health pool swallows her burst
Spirit Visage sustain outlasts her damage

start.why: Picked in 59.4% of games (39.3% WR, 219 games) — the regen-on-hit passive directly answers her auto-reliant Snip Snip! poke in the levels where she's strongest.

boots.why: Run in 64.7% of games (43.1% WR, 216 games) — you need the raw movement speed to close the gap on her before Hallowed Mist comes back up.

core.why: Top build path (50% WR, 50 games) — the health pool is the direct counter to her percent-health magic poke.
Second item in the same path — stacks more max health, which scales both Infected Cleaver's damage and your survivability against her.
Closes out the top path — the magic resist and heal amp make Adrenaline Rush and Burning Agony's drain sustain through her remaining damage.

situational.when: she's snowballing off A Thousand Cuts and auto-attacking you in extended trades
you need the grievous wounds earlier to shut down her on-hit healing
the lane is stable and you want more dueling power instead of pure survival

runes.keystoneWhy: Run in both top rune pages for this matchup (52.3% and 14.1% pick) — the per-hit heal and max-health scaling directly offset her poke-based harass.

summoners.why: Best measured win rate of the three combos (42.9% over a 35.2% pick sample) — Flash covers the gap-close onto her when Hallowed Mist drops, Teleport keeps you relevant since you're losing the lane's resource race early.

playing.title: Poke from max Q range
playing.detail: Infected Cleaver (975 range, 4s cooldown) outranges both her Q (450) and E (400). Throw it on cooldown whenever she pushes forward instead of waiting to all-in.

playing.title: Track her Hallowed Mist cooldown
playing.detail: W is 22/21/20/19/18s by rank. Once she's burned it to poke or disengage, that's your window — she has nothing else to escape with.

playing.title: Don't eat the center of Snip Snip!
playing.detail: Snip Snip! deals true damage to units in the center of the cone on each of its up to 6 snips. Sidestep the center line rather than standing in it.

playing.title: Pop Masochism when she commits
playing.detail: E (Masochism) scales AD off missing health on a 7s cooldown. Save it for the moment she dashes in with E (Skip 'n Slash), since that's when she's stuck in melee with you.

playing.title: Burn her in melee, don't stand off
playing.detail: W (Burning Agony) only reaches 325 range but drains your health for continual damage — it's only worth it once you're already fighting at close range with a health lead from Heartsteel/Warmog's.

playing.title: Use Sadism to finish, not flee
playing.detail: Sadism (75s cooldown) trades health for movement speed and heavy regen. Pop it mid-fight once she's out of Hallowed Mist and committed, not as an escape tool.

playing.title: Buy grievous wounds if she snowballs
playing.detail: If A Thousand Cuts healing is keeping her alive through your trades, Bramble Vest or Thornmail directly cuts that sustain loop off.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/sample figures are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch; the matchup reasoning and timing advice are my own tactical read, not measured.
